tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this for deep research that works with a search and fetch pair. It takes one query, either a sentence naming a Flatio city or country or a JSON object with the guest's filters, and returns up to 10 listings as id, title and URL. A query that names no Flatio city or country gives an empty list. G

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Use this for deep research after search. It takes one id that search returned and gives that listing's facts as text, with the monthly rent and its URL on flatio.com. flatio_get_listing returns the same listing as fields and prices exact dates. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "flatio_search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
